Section: 1.1. Equal Opportunity and Anti-Harassment (POSH)
Content:
### 1.1. Equal Opportunity and Anti-Harassment (POSH)
- The organization is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and harassment-free work environment regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or age.
- Zero Tolerance: Bullying, micro-aggressions, unwanted physical contact, sexual harassment, or discriminatory remarks will lead to immediate disciplinary inquiry and possible termination.
- Reporting: Concerns can be raised directly to the Ethics Committee or anonymously via the **SpeakUp Ethics Hotline** at `ethics-hotline@enterprise.org`.

Content:
### 2.2. Gifts, Hospitality, and Anti-Bribery
- Employees may not solicit or accept personal gifts, hospitality, or entertainment from vendors, clients, or partners exceeding a value of **$50 USD**.
- Any gifts valued over $50 USD must be disclosed to the Compliance Team and either politely returned or placed in the communal company raffle.
- Cash or cash equivalents (gift cards, prepaid debit cards) of any amount are strictly prohibited.

header: 2.1. Annual Paid Time Off (PTO / Earned Leave)
text:
Policy Document: leave_policy.md
Section: 2.1. Annual Paid Time Off (PTO / Earned Leave)
Content:
### 2.1. Annual Paid Time Off (PTO / Earned Leave)
- **Entitlement:** All full-time employees accrue **20 days** of Annual Leave per calendar year (accrued at 1.67 days per full calendar month worked).
- **Carryover Limit:** A maximum of **5 unused Annual Leave days** can be carried forward into the subsequent calendar year. Any additional accrued days beyond 5 will lapse automatically on December 31.
- **Advance Notice Requirement:** Planned leaves exceeding 3 consecutive business days require at least **5 business days prior notice** and manager approval via the HR Portal.

text:
Policy Document: leave_policy.md
Section: 2.2. Sick and Medical Leave
Content:
### 2.2. Sick and Medical Leave
- **Entitlement:** Employees are granted **10 days** of paid Sick Leave annually, credited on January 1 of each calendar year.
- **Medical Certification:** For any consecutive medical absence lasting **3 or more business days**, an official medical certificate from a licensed healthcare practitioner must be uploaded to the HR portal within 48 hours of returning to work.
- **Non-Accumulative:** Sick leave cannot be carried forward to the next year and is not encashable upon resignation or termination.

text:
Policy Document: leave_policy.md
Section: 2.3. Parental Leave
Content:
### 2.3. Parental Leave
- **Maternity Leave:** Eligible female employees are entitled to **26 weeks (182 calendar days)** of fully paid maternity leave for up to two surviving children. A minimum of 80 days of service in the preceding 12 months is required.
- **Paternity / Secondary Caregiver Leave:** Eligible secondary caregivers receive **4 weeks (20 working days)** of fully paid paternity leave, which must be availed within 6 months of childbirth or legal adoption.
- **Adoption Leave:** Primary adoptive parents of a child below the age of 1 year are entitled to **12 weeks** of paid leave.

### 2.4. Bereavement Leave
- Employees may avail up to **5 consecutive business days** of paid bereavement leave in the event of the demise of an immediate family member (spouse, child, parent, sibling, or parent-in-law).
- Up to **2 consecutive business days** of paid leave are granted for extended family members (grandparents, aunts, uncles).

- Comp-off must be utilized within **60 calendar days** from the date worked; otherwise, it expires.

text:
Policy Document: leave_policy.md
Section: 3. Leave Application and Approval Workflow
Content:
## 3. Leave Application and Approval Workflow
1. All leave requests must be submitted through the internal **HRIS Portal**.
2. Requests for casual/planned leaves of 1–2 days must be submitted at least **48 hours in advance**.
3. In case of emergency or sudden illness, the employee must notify their direct reporting manager via email or Slack by **9:30 AM** on the morning of absence.
4. Managers must approve or reject leave requests within **3 business days** of submission.

Section: Q1: What should I expect on my first working day?
Content:
### Q1: What should I expect on my first working day?
- **Orientation Schedule:** Day 1 begins at **9:30 AM** with a corporate welcome orientation led by the People Operations team.
- **IT Setup:** You will receive your corporate laptop credentials, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) setup prompt, and single sign-on (SSO) login info during the IT session at 11:00 AM.
- **Buddy Program:** You will be introduced to your designated "Onboarding Buddy" who will assist you with everyday workplace norms, tools, and introductions.

### Q2: What hardware and peripherals are provided to new joiners?
- Standard issue includes a choice between a 16-inch Apple MacBook Pro or a Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon.

- Replacement or upgrades for hardware can be requested through the IT Service Desk portal after 24 months of use.

text:

Section: Q3: When and how do I enroll in health insurance and benefits?

### Q3: When and how do I enroll in health insurance and benefits?
- Benefits enrollment window is open for **30 calendar days** starting from your official Date of Joining.
- Coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance becomes active on the **1st day of the month immediately following your start date**.
- You can add eligible dependents (spouse, children under 26) through the Benefits Portal under the "Life Events & Enrollment" section.

header: Q4: How long is the probationary period?
text:
Policy Document: onboarding_faq.md
Section: Q4: How long is the probationary period?
Content:
### Q4: How long is the probationary period?
- The standard probation period for all new full-time employees is **90 calendar days (3 months)**.
- At the 45-day midpoint, a check-in meeting is conducted between the employee and manager to review progress against 30-60-90 day goals.
- A formal probation clearance review occurs before day 90. Upon successful completion, confirmation of employment is issued in writing.

text:

Section: Q5: How is payroll processed, and when do I get paid?
Content:
### Q5: How is payroll processed, and when do I get paid?
- Salaries are disbursed on the **last working day of each calendar month**.
- Direct bank deposit details must be submitted in the HR Payroll portal by the **15th of your first month** to prevent payment processing delays.
- Monthly payslips are generated electronically and accessible via the Payroll section of the HR portal.
